text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: The charges this time are damage to property through fighting and disturbing the neighbours with the noise from their argument. Do you have anything to say, both of you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
罪状はケンカによる器物損壊と、
言い争いの騒音による近所迷惑ですね～
何か言うことはありますか～、
お二人とも？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi and Kanon
text_block_list.text: It's YOUR fault, Kanon-san!" "TSUMUGI-SAN is at fault here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
「カノンさんが悪いです！」
「ツムギさんが悪いですわ！」

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: It's been a while since their fight ended, yet they're still boiling so hot~ Lord Kishi-san, what should we do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ケンカが終わってから時間も経つのに
まだ茹で上がったままですか～
騎士殿さん、
どうしましょうか～？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: As if I'd do such a thing, it's embarassing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
嫌ですよそんなこと、
恥ずかしいですもん。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: I do not even understand this "punishment". Can you stop messing around?
text_block_list.orig_text:
意味が分かりませんわ。
ふざけるのも大概にしていただけますこと？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi and Kanon
text_block_list.text: ...Nyan.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……にゃん。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Why am I being put through this, too...? It's Kanon who's at fault here, nyan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで私がこんな目に……
悪いのはカノンさんですにゃん。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Since you just accepted the punishment, it is clear that you were also at fault, Tsumugi-san, nyan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
罰を受け入れている時点で
ツムギさんにも非があったことは確実ですにゃん？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Then that goes for you too, Kanon-san, nyan! Or rather, even if I am somehow in the wrong, Kanon-san you're EVEN MORE wrong, nyan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはカノンさんだって同じですにゃん！
っていうか
仮に私が悪かったとしても
カノンさんの方がもっと悪いですにゃん！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Huuuuuuuuuh?! If that is the case, then you are more, WAY MORE, in the wrong, Tsumugi-san, nyan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～～～～！？
それならあたくし様よりも
ツムギさんの方がもっともっと悪いですにゃん！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Then, Kanon-san, you are more, more, EVEN WAY MORE in the wrong, nyan!
text_block_list.orig_text: ならカノンさんの方がもっともっともーっと悪いですにゃん！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi and Kanon
text_block_list.text: *HISSSSSSSSSSS*!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ふしゃあーーーーっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: From there, the childish arguing between the two "cats" resumed, and continued until both were exhausted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこからは子どものような言い争いが再び始まって、
二人が疲れ果てるまで続いたのだった。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ............Then, it's not like I'd want to, but I'll start. I acknowledge your honesty and your unwillingness to give up. ...We've fought together, after all. Reluctantly. Just barely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
………………じゃあ、
不本意ですけど私から。
あなたの心根の真っ直ぐさと諦めの悪いところは認めてますよ。
……共闘した仲ではありますから。
一応。
仕方なく。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! I have already admitted enough to entrust you with my back in a fight. Since you are an Idol, I do not sense any aura of inferiority coming from you, and you have also got guts. Probably. Most likely.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん……っ。
あたくし様も
背中を預ける程度には認めていますわ。
アイドルと言うだけあって
下々オーラを感じませんし、
根性もありますから。
多分。
恐らく。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You're right... But Kanon-san, you should learn the time and place to do your loud laughs...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね……
でもカノンさん、
高笑いはもう少し時と場所を弁えてもらえると……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: The time and place...? No way, Tsumugi-san, it is up to me WHEN and WHERE to laugh loudly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
弁える……？
いいえ
ツムギさん、
いつどこで高笑いするかは
あたくし様の自由ですわ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: WHA-... that's what I mean! That kind of arrogant behavior is what's bothering other people!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ、
そういうところですよ！？
大体そういう傍若無人な振る舞いが
他の人の迷惑になっててですね！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: OH HO HO HO♪ If we are talking about arrogant and annoying behaviour, someone like you, who always snaps and gets all heated up, is just as much of a nuisance, you know, Tsumugi-san~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヲ～
ッホッホッ♪
そうやってすぐに噛み付いてヒートアップなさるツムギさんも
迷惑である点は同じでしてよ～～～～？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: LIKE. I. JUST. SAID!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だぁー
かぁー
らぁー！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: HUUUUUUUUUUUUUUH~???

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...Kanon and Tsumugi seemed to be making up for a moment, but they soon started fighting again. In the end, the fight continued until they were both exhausted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一瞬仲直りの流れに乗ったはずが、
すぐにケンカを再開してしまうカノンとツムギ。
結局、
そのケンカは二人が疲れ果てるまで続いたのだった。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Very well! Let the show begin, it's a rap battle showdown! And in the end, I’ll wear the crown!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいでしょう！　
始まるショー！
決着はラップバトル！　
結局は私が勝ち取る！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: The match has already begun, has it not. In that case!
text_block_list.orig_text:
勝負はもう始まっている、
ということですのね。
ならば！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Weak lyrics! Cannot touch me, not a bit! Turn the heat up, or are you going to give up? Try dissing my style, this is a freestyle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヌルいリリック！　
届きませんわ
おまったく！
アツくなりなさいなヒートアップ！　
それともアナタはギブアップ？
──ディスってみなさいな、
これはフリースタイル！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Your outfit's whack!
text_block_list.orig_text: 服が変！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Like I have told you before, this is NOT my fashion sense!
text_block_list.orig_text: だからこれはあたくし様のファッションセンスじゃありませんわー！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Pathetic rich girl! A total disaster! Strutting around like an ego-blaster! You're so dense, what's that fashion sense!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ポンコツ令嬢！　
無惨な惨状！
傍若無人なあなたのスタンス！
拾ってきなさいファッションセンスー！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Fake tsundere! Idol with a mouth full of sass! Zip it shut, loudmouth... show some class! That bratty act? I’ll kick your... pass!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツンデレ気取る！　
暴言アイドル！
やかましいお口にお似合いチャック！
ナマイキ態度にかましますわよキックー！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Far from ending, it's only getting more heated up~ I don't dislike the two of them rapping with their souls like this~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
終わるどころか
ヒートアップする一方ですね～
魂でラップするお二人、
嫌いじゃないですよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In the end, the rap battle continued without any judges or commentary until both were exhausted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局、
そのラップバトルは審査員も判定もないままに、
二人が疲れ果てるまで続いたのだった。
